decision: Accepted after native/3x complete motion review; source crop and palette conversion only

actual_submitted_arguments.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT.
Style: chunky deliberate pixel-art clusters, colored dark outlines, orthographic three-quarter top-down rectangular-grid camera. Neutral upper-left daytime light. True transparent background, no ground shadow, labels, scenery, target, aura, glow, blur or excessive gore. Preserve large readable masses for reduction to a 64x64 native canvas, ground pivot (32,60), standing body about 42 pixels high. Muted rot/stone greens, violet undersides, worn brown cloth, small cold highlights. The Giant must be clearly broader and taller than the ordinary enemies but fit the farm's established camera. Keep hands and feet fully within each separate source cell.

Primary request: EXACTLY THREE ordered leftward slam poses, ONE HORIZONTAL ROW with generous transparent separators. Image 1 is the accepted Giant identity reference; Image 2 the ordinary material/camera reference. Frame0 striking giant fist reaches left and down at ground/contact height, frame1 low heavy follow-through with bent knees, frame2 recovers to full master standing height. Preserve identity, torso mass and scale across frames; measure scale from last standing pose. No impact particles or target baked in, no aura or scene. Full hands fit individual cells with transparent clearance.
